body:
"i did the right thing." that's richard marx on passing up the chance to co-write with a 15-year-old Taylor — and i cannot stop thinking about it 😭

on bob lefsetz's podcast he told the story: scott borchetta, fresh off starting big machine, played him "the first two or three Taylor Swift demos" and asked if he'd write with her. marx asked, "scott, what is she, 15?" borchetta said yes. marx said no.

his rule for co-writing is that he has to believe he can help an artist "in a way that you can't already help yourself" — and looking at this teenager, he just didn't see what he'd add.

that's the part that undoes me. she's the biggest act in the world now, and she was already so fully there on those first demos that a hit-maker looked at a 15-year-old and thought: she doesn't need me.

tag the friend who needs the reminder that she was always this good 💛
